legal.privacy.summary: In short: Hanged plays offline and keeps your game on your phone. Our server receives only what the leaderboard and Versus need: a random account number, your player name and your game stats. No ads, no tracking, and we never sell your information.
legal.privacy.who.title: 1. Who we are
legal.privacy.who.body:
Hanged: word guessing game (“Hanged”) is made by an independent developer, shown as the seller on the game's App Store and Google Play pages (“we”, “us”). We are responsible for your information (its “controller”, in the words of European law).
This policy explains what the game collects, why, who sees it and the choices you have. It covers the app and the online services behind it: the leaderboard, Versus, friends and invite links.
legal.privacy.device.title: 2. What stays on your phone
legal.privacy.device.body: Your game is saved on your phone: your progress, tokens, characters, settings, daily streak, and the rounds waiting to be sent. Reminders are planned by your phone too. Nothing leaves your phone except what the next sections list, and deleting the app deletes what it saved.
legal.privacy.collect.title: 3. What our server receives, and why
legal.privacy.collect.body:
When you're online, the game sends our server a copy of a few things:
• Your account: a random account number and a secret key, made the first time the game connects. No email, password or phone number. We store only a scrambled (hashed) form of the key.
• Your profile and progress: your player name, character, language, words guessed, level, token balance, and totals such as rounds played and won, tokens earned and wrong guesses. They build the leaderboard.
• Your finished rounds: the word, the level, whether you won, wrong guesses, tokens paid, letters bought, and when. They feed the weekly leaderboard and our word statistics (which words are won or lost most), which help us make the game fairer. Word statistics are counts per word and per day, with nothing that says who played.
• Technical logs: like any online service, our server records requests, such as the time, the page or address called and your IP address, to keep the service running, stop abuse and fix problems.
• Emails: if you write to us, we keep the conversation so we can answer you.
legal.privacy.versus.title: 4. Versus and friends
legal.privacy.versus.body:
If you play Versus, our server also keeps your Versus rating and the number of matches you played and won, your friends, friend requests, the players you block, and your invite code. While you're connected, your friends can see that you're online.
During a match, the server receives your guesses so it can judge them, and in Word Duel the word you pick for your opponent. Match details are not kept after the match: only your rating and totals change.
If you report a player, we keep who reported whom, the reason and when, so we can look into it.
legal.privacy.public.title: 5. What other players see
legal.privacy.public.body:
Your player name and character are public. They show on the leaderboard with your score, level and rank, and in Versus. Players can find you by name to send you a friend request.
Pick a name you're happy for everyone to see, and never use personal details such as your full name, age or address.
legal.privacy.never.title: 6. What we never do
legal.privacy.never.body:
• No advertising, and no advertising or analytics tools in the game.
• No tracking you across other apps or websites.
• We never sell your information or share it for advertising.
• We don't ask for your location, contacts, photos, camera or microphone.
legal.privacy.permissions.title: 7. Permissions on your phone
legal.privacy.permissions.body:
• Notifications: only if you allow them, for the daily reminder. Your phone plans and shows them; no notification server is involved. Turn them off in Profile or in your phone's settings.
• Paste (iPhone): if a friend's invite link brought you here, the first screen can show a Paste button. The game only checks whether the clipboard holds a link, and reads it only if you tap Paste, to find the invite code.
• Install referrer (Android): if you installed the game from a friend's invite link, the game reads the invite code Google Play passes along, once, on first launch.
• Store rating: the game may ask Apple or Google, once, to show their rating window. Your rating goes to them, not to us.
legal.privacy.share.title: 8. Who we share it with
legal.privacy.bases.title: 9. Our legal reasons
legal.privacy.keep.title: 10. How long we keep it
legal.privacy.keep.body:
• Your account and everything tied to it: until you delete your account.
• Word and match statistics: they're counts with nothing that points back to you, so they stay.
• Server logs: kept by our hosting provider for a limited time, then deleted.
• Database backups: they may hold a copy for a short time before they're replaced.
• Support emails: as long as we need them to help you.
legal.privacy.delete.title: 11. Deleting your account
legal.privacy.delete.body:
Go to Profile › Delete account. It needs an internet connection: our server deletes your account first, along with your friends, requests, blocks, weekly scores and any reports you made or received, then the game starts fresh on your phone. This can't be undone.
Deleting the app alone doesn't delete your account on our server, and your name stays on the leaderboard. If you no longer have the app, email us with your player name and we'll help.
legal.privacy.rights.title: 12. Your rights
legal.privacy.rights.body:
Depending on where you live, you can ask to know what we hold about you, get a copy of it, correct it, delete it, limit or object to how we use it, and withdraw a consent you gave. We'll never treat you differently for using these rights.
You can change your name and delete your account yourself, in Profile. For anything else, email us with your player name. We may ask for something that shows the account is yours, and we'll answer within one month. You can also complain to your data protection authority.
legal.privacy.security.title: 13. Keeping it safe
legal.privacy.security.body: Everything between the game and our server travels encrypted (HTTPS). Your secret key is stored only in hashed form, only we can reach the server's data, and the game sends as little as it needs. No system is perfectly secure, but if a breach affects you, we'll tell you as the law requires.
legal.privacy.transfers.title: 14. Where your data is stored
legal.privacy.transfers.body: Our server runs in the United States. If you live elsewhere, your information is transferred there, protected by our provider's data processing agreement, which includes the European Commission's standard contractual clauses and their United Kingdom and Swiss versions.
legal.privacy.children.title: 15. Children
legal.privacy.children.body: Hanged is not meant for children under 13, or under the minimum age for online services in their country, and we don't knowingly collect their information. If you're a parent and think your child has given us information, email us and we'll delete it.
legal.privacy.changes.title: 16. Changes to this policy
legal.privacy.changes.body: If we change this policy, we'll update the date at the top. If the change matters, the game will show you the new text and ask you to accept it before you play on.
legal.privacy.contact.title: 17. Contact us
legal.privacy.contact.body: A question about your privacy, or a request about your data? Write to us:
legal.terms.summary: Welcome to Hanged! These terms are the rules for playing it. We kept them as short and clear as we could, so please read them: by playing, you agree to them.
legal.terms.agree.title: 1. Agreeing to these terms
legal.terms.agree.body:
These terms are an agreement between you and the developer of Hanged (“we”, “us”), shown as the seller on the game's App Store and Google Play pages. They cover the app and its online services: the leaderboard, Versus, friends and invite links. Our Privacy policy explains how we handle your information.
You must be at least 13 to play. If you're under 18, read these terms with a parent or guardian, who agrees to them for you. If you don't agree, please don't play.
legal.terms.license.title: 2. Your license to play
legal.terms.license.body: We give you a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to download and play Hanged on devices you own or control, for your own fun and not for business. You may not copy, sell, rent, lend or redistribute the game, or reverse-engineer, decompile or modify it, except where the law allows it. Everything we don't expressly give you, we keep.
legal.terms.account.title: 3. Your account
legal.terms.fair.title: 4. Playing fair
legal.terms.name.title: 5. Your player name
legal.terms.name.body:
Your name is public. It must not be offensive, hateful or sexual, pretend to be the game or its staff, or use someone else's name or rights. The game filters names, but filters miss things: we may change or remove any name, and give you a random one, without notice.
If a player bothers you, block or report them from the Friends screen.
legal.terms.tokens.title: 6. Tokens and characters
legal.terms.tokens.body: You earn tokens by playing and spend them in the game, on letters and characters. Tokens and characters have no money value: they can't be bought, sold, traded or exchanged for money or anything outside the game, and you don't own them; you have a license to use them in the game. We may rebalance rewards, prices and levels. They're lost if you delete your account or the app.
legal.terms.online.title: 7. The leaderboard and Versus
legal.terms.online.body:
Scores and ratings come from what the game reports. To keep them fair, we may correct, hide or reset scores, ratings or boards, and remove players who break these terms.
The online features need an internet connection. We may pause them at any time, for example for maintenance, and a match stopped by a lost connection or a server restart may not count.
legal.terms.content.title: 8. Our content
legal.terms.content.body: The game, its characters, art, music, sounds, names, logos and code belong to us or the people who license them to us, and are protected by law. These terms don't let you use them outside the game. The word descriptions come from the sources listed in Profile › Credits, under their own licenses.
legal.terms.changes.title: 9. Changes to the game and these terms
legal.terms.changes.body:
We keep improving Hanged, so features, levels, rules and prices in tokens may change, and we may stop some online features, or the game, at any time. Like all software, Hanged has bugs; we fix what we can, starting with anything that touches security or privacy.
If we change these terms, we'll update the date at the top. If the change matters, the game will ask you to accept the new terms before you play on.
legal.terms.ending.title: 10. Stopping
legal.terms.ending.body: You can stop playing at any time, and delete your account in Profile › Delete account. We may suspend or delete an account, or block it from the online features, if it breaks these terms or puts other players or the service at risk. Sections 8, 11, 12 and 14 still apply after the end.
legal.terms.warranty.title: 11. No warranty
legal.terms.warranty.body: To the extent the law allows, Hanged is provided “as is” and “as available”, with all faults and without any warranty, express or implied, including of quality, fitness for a particular purpose and non-infringement. We don't promise that the game or its online services will always be available or free of errors, or that progress can never be lost. Some countries don't allow these exclusions, so they may not apply to you.
legal.terms.liability.title: 12. Limits of our liability
legal.terms.liability.body:
To the extent the law allows, we're not liable for indirect, incidental, special or consequential damages, or for lost data, progress, tokens or profits, arising from the game or these terms, and our total liability to you won't exceed fifty US dollars (US$50).
Nothing in these terms limits liability that the law doesn't allow us to limit, such as for death or personal injury caused by our negligence, or for fraud, or takes away your legal rights as a consumer.
legal.terms.stores.title: 13. Apple and Google
legal.terms.general.title: 14. Law and disputes
legal.terms.general.body:
These terms are governed by the law of the country where we are established, without regard to its conflict-of-law rules. If you live in a country whose law gives you that right, such as in the European Union or the United Kingdom, you also keep the protection of its mandatory consumer law and can bring a claim in your local courts.
If a part of these terms can't be enforced, the rest still applies. If we don't enforce a right, we haven't given it up. These terms and the Privacy policy are the whole agreement between you and us about Hanged.
If something goes wrong, please email us first: most problems are solved quickly that way.
legal.terms.contact.title: 15. Contact us
legal.terms.contact.body: A question about these terms? Write to us:

rules.goal.title: Keep them floating
rules.goal.body: Your character floats under {max} balloons. Guess the secret word before they all pop!
rules.guess.title: Guessing
rules.guess.body: Tap a letter. If it's in the word, every copy of it shows up. If it isn't, a balloon pops. Each letter can only be tried once.
rules.help.title: A little help
rules.help.body: Every word starts with a few letters showing. The word's description is always visible for free to help you guess. On the first levels, some letters that aren't in the word are taken off the keyboard.
rules.hard.title: Harder words
rules.hard.body: From level {lettersLevel}, you can reveal {letterCount} hidden letters for {letterCost} tokens, once per word. From level {subjectLevel}, the word's subject is shown for free.
rules.tokens.title: Tokens
rules.tokens.body: Every word you guess pays tokens, and harder levels pay more. Guess {streak} words in a row for a bonus. Spend tokens on letters and new characters.
rules.levels.title: Levels
rules.levels.body: There are {levels} levels, and the words get harder as you climb. Lose {drop} words in a row and you step back one level. You'll be back up in no time!
rules.board.title: Leaderboard
rules.board.body: Your score is the number of words you've guessed. Spending tokens never lowers it.
rules.daily.title: Daily streak
rules.daily.body: Finish a word every day, won or lost, to grow your daily streak. Miss a day and it starts again at 1. Turn on the daily reminder in your profile: one nudge a day, and only if you haven't played yet.
reminderAsk.title: Keep your streak going?
reminderAsk.body: {name} can send you one friendly reminder a day, only on days you haven't played yet.
reminderAsk.note: You can change this anytime in your profile.

credits.intro: The English words use the sources below. The other languages have their own word banks and original clues.
credits.wordnet.title: Open English WordNet

Licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0). Changes made: the definitions are reworded in plain, shorter English for the game, so they never give the answer away; for some words, the description uses a more common meaning than the one in the dictionary.

versus.title: Versus
versus.modes.rush.name: Word Rush
versus.modes.rush.rules: Everyone gets the same words in the same order. Guess as many as you can before the {time} clock runs out. Each word allows {misses} misses, and you can skip one you're stuck on. Most words wins; on a tie, fewer misses, then whoever got there first.
versus.modes.battle.name: Balloon Battle
versus.modes.battle.rules: Everyone floats under {balloons} balloons and plays the same words. A miss pops one of your balloons. Every word you guess pops one of the leader's balloons, or two if you made no miss. Skipping a word costs a balloon. The last one still floating wins.
versus.modes.duel.name: Word Duel
versus.modes.duel.tagline: Pick a word for your rival
versus.modes.duel.rules: One against one. Each round, you both pick a word for the other (one of your cards, or type your own), then you both guess at the same time. Guessing your word beats missing it; then fewer misses wins, then the faster. Best of {rounds} rounds.

rules.versus.title: Versus
rules.versus.body: Play online against friends or random players: Word Rush, Balloon Battle and Word Duel. Each mode's rules are on its card in the Versus tab. Versus has its own rating: its matches don't count toward the leaderboard and don't pay tokens. When nobody's free to play, the game fills the match with computer players at your level, so a match always starts.
